title: Verify that an Administrator can schedule an approved newsletter for a future date and it sends automatically at that time
description: Functional-High: manual — depends on a real scheduled/cron send firing.

steps.expected: Status changes to Scheduled; success toast shown (EN+AR)

steps.action: Wait until (or simulate) the scheduled time elapses
steps.expected: At the scheduled time, newsletter automatically sends to all active subscribers; status changes to Published

title: Verify that a Newsletter Issue Email auto-pulls content only from currently enabled and published modules
description: Functional-High: manual — requires inspecting real sent email content, no email infra.

steps.action: Open an Approved newsletter's Send/Schedule step
Disable the Circulars & Announcements toggle; leave Latest News, Upcoming Events, Publications & Research enabled
steps.expected: Circulars & Announcements toggle set to Disabled
Newsletter publishes and sends; success toast shown
Sent email contains Latest News, Upcoming Events, and Publications & Research content, and does NOT contain a Circulars & Announcements section

title: Verify that archiving a newsletter while it is in Scheduled status cancels the pending send
description: Edge: manual — depends on a genuinely pending scheduled send, no cron/email infra to verify cancellation deterministically.

steps.action: Schedule a newsletter for a future date
Before the scheduled time elapses, open the newsletter and click Archive
steps.expected: Status changes to Archived; the pending scheduled send is cancelled and no email is sent at the original scheduled time
